Family photography in Provo & Orem

There’s room for everyone to be themselves.

We’ll make the portrait you want to hang on the wall, and leave time for the moments you couldn’t plan: small hands reaching for yours, siblings making each other laugh, the way you all lean together. Tell me about your family’s ages and energy so we can plan a session around them.

Before we meet

A few good questions.

What if my children don’t want to sit still?

They don’t need to sit still the whole time. We can build in movement, little breaks, and time together. Bring a snack and a favorite small toy if that helps.

Can we include extended family?

Yes—tell me your group size and the combinations you’d like photographed. I’ll put together a quote and a plan with enough time for everyone.

Where should our session take place?

Start with somewhere that feels like your family: a familiar outdoor setting, a quiet trail, or an open space. We’ll discuss light, access, season, and comfort before choosing a location.
